component.name: Lapse
component.summary: Save the last moments of your game and trim clips

description.p: Lapse keeps the last minutes of your screen in memory with GPU Screen Recorder. Press a key and the moment is saved as a clip, in a folder named after the game.

ul.li: Replay buffer, full recording and screenshots on global hotkeys
Clip library with a player and a lossless trimmer
Automatic clips of kill streaks in Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2
Discord Rich Presence and sharing links
